summary: Improve speed networking handling of auto-register users when session start is too soon from creation

ai.s: Improves Speed Networking auto-registration so sessions that start within minutes of creation still get their users registered.
ai.pr: Auto-registration ran on an hourly cron and only for sessions starting in the future, so a session created at 14:05 and starting at 14:10 had already begun by the 15:00 run and was skipped.
ai.wy: Part of improving the Speed Networking service's reliability.
ai.oc: Auto-registration handling to be changed so short-notice Speed Networking sessions are not missed by the hourly job.

ai.s: Improves the Country Manager so exhibitor imports carry country and city data correctly and duplicate cities are prevented and cleaned up.
ai.pr: Exhibitor imports were not working or not populating country, city and phone, and API data created duplicate cities across countries because names were not validated against the Wikipedia database.
ai.wy: Admin Panel workflow improvement; bad location data affects event settings, timezones, registration and profiles.
ai.oc: Proposed city dropdown with auto-populated fields, SuperAdmin-only Add New City, flagged mismatches during API import and a client-by-client duplicate clean-up; open questions remain.
